description: This file defines the CalendarSyncOperation class, which models an operation to synchronize calendar data within the SuiteCRM project. It includes constructor and getter methods for properties such as user ID, calendar account ID, subject ID, location, action, and an optional payload.

classes.name: CalendarSyncOperation
classes.description: This class represents a calendar synchronization operation, encapsulating details like user ID, calendar account ID, subject ID, location, action, and an optional payload.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of CalendarSyncOperation with specified properties.

methods.name: getUserId
methods.description: Returns the user ID associated with the synchronization operation.

methods.name: getSubjectId
methods.description: Returns the subject ID related to the synchronization operation.

methods.name: getPayload
methods.description: Returns the optional payload, which is a CalendarAccountEvent object.
